title: GPU_MODE Accuses Meta Muse Spark Challenge Team of Stealing Code

tickers.name: Meta Platforms, Inc. Class A Common Stock

summary:
The organizers of the Muse Spark optimization competition converted stolen open source software into a closed source binary using an AI agent, Mark Saroufim of GPU_MODE alleged. Saroufim stated that the team used the agent to rewrite GPU_MODE's code into the Go programming language to mask the plagiarism and avoid providing credit, while also failing to commit to releasing the challenge entries to the public.

The $100,000 competition was launched by Meta, Paradigm, and Andromeda AI to find the fastest implementation of the Muse Spark model. The top prize includes $50,000 and an H200 GPU signed by the Meta team, with the project drawing promotional support from figures including Daniel Gross and Alexandr Wang.
